title: 動詞時態：四大核心時態 + 時間線索
courseTitle: TOEIC 金色證書 90 天訓練
source: 使用者提供的 Day 4 教材

sections.title: Day 4 學習概覽
sections.markdown: 今天正式從「詞性」進入 **動詞時態**。前 3 天已完成詞性、五大句型與 Part 2 基本間接回答；目前沒有收到實際作答分數，因此今天先維持 **860+ 標準難度**，並加入更接近正式 TOEIC 的時間線索陷阱。今天建議 **90～110 分鐘**，順序仍然是先做題，再看解析。

sections.title: ① 今日高頻單字 30 個
sections.markdown:
今天主題：**Travel / Transportation / Business Trip**

| # | 單字 | 中文 | TOEIC 高頻搭配 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | itinerary | 行程表 | travel itinerary |
| 2 | departure | 出發 | departure time |
| 3 | arrival | 抵達 | arrival time |
| 4 | destination | 目的地 | final destination |
| 5 | passenger | 乘客 | airline passenger |
| 6 | reservation | 預約 | make a reservation |
| 7 | accommodation | 住宿 | hotel accommodation |
| 8 | transportation | 交通運輸 | public transportation |
| 9 | commute | 通勤 | commute to work |
| 10 | board | 登上 | board a flight |
| 11 | delay | 延誤 | flight delay |
| 12 | cancel | 取消 | cancel a reservation |
| 13 | luggage | 行李 | carry-on luggage |
| 14 | baggage | 行李 | baggage claim |
| 15 | fare | 票價 | train fare |
| 16 | route | 路線 | bus route |
| 17 | terminal | 航廈；終點站 | airport terminal |
| 18 | platform | 月台 | train platform |
| 19 | transfer | 轉乘 | transfer to another train |
| 20 | vehicle | 車輛 | company vehicle |
| 21 | rental | 租賃 | car rental |
| 22 | reimburse | 報銷；償還 | reimburse expenses |
| 23 | reimbursement | 報銷款 | request reimbursement |
| 24 | expense | 費用 | travel expenses |
| 25 | receipt | 收據 | keep the receipt |
| 26 | conference | 會議 | attend a conference |
| 27 | overseas | 海外 | overseas business trip |
| 28 | approximately | 大約 | approximately 20 minutes |
| 29 | convenient | 方便的 | convenient location |
| 30 | accessible | 容易到達的 | easily accessible |

優先記：**make a reservation / departure time / baggage claim / travel expenses / request reimbursement / board a flight / flight delay / final destination**。luggage / baggage 通常是不可數名詞，應說 two pieces of luggage，不是 two luggages。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜TOEIC 四大核心時態
sections.markdown:
Part 5 的時態題不要先看選項，第一件事是**找時間線索**。

### 現在簡單式

表示固定、習慣、事實：The train **leaves** at 8:30 every morning. 訊號：usually / often / every / regularly。

### 現在進行式

表示現在正在發生：The manager **is meeting** a client right now. 訊號：now / currently / at the moment。

### 過去簡單式

已完成的過去事件：Ms. Chen **attended** the conference last week. 訊號：yesterday / last week / ago / in 2025。

### 現在完成式

have / has + p.p.：The company **has opened** three new offices this year. 事情發生於過去，但和現在有關。訊號：since / for / already / yet / recently / so far。

sections.title: ③ Since 與 For
sections.markdown:
**since + 起點**：since Monday / since 2024 / since January。

**for + 一段時間**：for three days / for five years / for several months。

> Mr. Lee has worked here **since 2020**.

> Mr. Lee has worked here **for six years**.

看到 since / for 時，Part 5 很常考現在完成式。

sections.title: ④ 時態陷阱
sections.markdown:
### Example 1

The company _____ several new employees **since January**. 答案 **has hired**。

### Example 2

Ms. Wang _____ the report **yesterday afternoon**. 答案 **completed**。

### Example 3

The accounting department _____ the invoices **every Friday**. 答案 **processes**。

### Example 4

Our sales representatives _____ with several clients **at the moment**. 答案 **are meeting**。

sections.title: ⑤ Listening｜Part 2 間接回答進階
sections.markdown:
### Q1

> When does Flight 825 arrive?

答案：**It has been delayed by an hour.** 沒有直接回答時間，但提供高度相關資訊。

### Q2

> Have you booked a hotel yet?

答案：**I'm going to do it this afternoon.** Have you...? 不一定回答 Yes / No。

### Q3

> Why hasn't Daniel arrived yet?

答案：**His train may have been delayed.**

### Q4

> Would you mind changing my reservation?

答案：**Certainly. What date would you prefer?** Would you mind...? 是禮貌請求。

### Q5

> Haven't you submitted your travel expenses yet?

答案：**I was waiting for one more receipt.** 否定問句直接找語意合理的回答。

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Part 7 定位閱讀
sections.markdown:
> **To:** Kevin Huang
> **From:** Travel Services
> **Subject:** Change to Your Flight Reservation
> Dear Mr. Huang,
> We are writing to inform you that your flight from Taipei to Singapore on September 18 has been changed because of an adjustment to the airline's schedule.
> Your original flight was scheduled to depart at 9:10 A.M. The new flight will depart at 11:25 A.M. from Terminal 2.
> Your seat assignment has not changed, and no additional payment is required.
> If the new departure time is inconvenient, please contact us by September 10. We can help you select another available flight at no additional charge.
> Travel Services

答案：**1B / 2C / 3A / 4A**。Q2 看到 NOT changed，立刻搜尋 has not changed，找到 seat assignment。Part 7 的重點不是背整封 Email，而是依題目定位。

sections.title: ⑦ TOEIC 仿真題｜8 題
sections.markdown: 請到「階段小考」完成 8 題時態仿真題，先找 since、ago、every、right now、recently 等時間線索。

sections.title: ⑧ 今日小考｜10 題
sections.markdown: 建議計時 **5 分鐘**。請到「階段小考」選擇 Day 4 小考作答。

sections.title: ⑨ 答案與解析
sections.markdown:
仿真題：**1 C / 2 B / 3 A / 4 C / 5 C / 6 B / 7 B / 8 C**。建立反射：since → 現在完成式；ago → 過去式；every → 現在簡單式；right now → 現在進行式；recently → 常用現在完成式。

今日小考：**1 C / 2 A / 3 B / 4 C / 5 C / 6 B / 7 A / 8 B / 9 A / 10 B**。Q7 When will the train arrive? 回答 It has been delayed again. 雖然沒有時間，但提供了目前無法給出原定抵達時間的原因。

sections.title: ⑩ 前三天錯題複習
sections.markdown: approve（動詞）→ approve the proposal；approval（名詞）→ obtain approval。respond（動詞）→ respond to the customer；response（名詞）→ receive a response；responsive（形容詞）→ responsive customer service。succeed（動詞）、success（名詞）、successful（形容詞）、successfully（副詞）。詞性題仍然使用：**位置 → 詞性 → 意思**。

sections.title: ⑪ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
把今天 30 個單字複習兩輪，特別記 make a reservation / board a flight / flight delay / baggage claim / travel expenses / request reimbursement / keep the receipt / final destination。

自己說出：since → 起點／常搭現在完成式；for → 時間長度／常搭現在完成式；yesterday → 過去式；every Monday → 現在簡單式；right now → 現在進行式；recently → 常搭現在完成式。

第二次小考限制 4 分鐘，目標 9/10 以上。**Day 4 核心：看到動詞題，第一反應不是翻譯，而是先找時間線索。**下一課進入主動語態 vs. 被動語態。

questions.prompt: The company _____ three new branches since the beginning of the year.
questions.explanation: since 搭配現在完成式 has opened。

questions.prompt: Mr. Chen _____ for the airport approximately thirty minutes ago.
The marketing team _____ its weekly meeting every Monday morning.
questions.explanation: every Monday 表示固定行為，使用現在簡單式。

questions.prompt: Our representatives _____ with an overseas client right now.
questions.explanation: right now 使用現在進行式。

questions.prompt: The airline _____ several changes to its schedule recently.
Ms. Lee _____ the conference in Tokyo last month.
questions.explanation: last month 是過去式訊號。

questions.prompt: The company has provided transportation services _____ more than twenty years.
Mr. Wang has worked in the sales department _____ 2021.
The company _____ significant progress since the project began.
The technicians _____ the new equipment at the moment.
questions.explanation: at the moment 使用現在進行式。

questions.prompt: Mr. Park has lived in Taipei _____ five years.
The restaurant has been at this location _____ 2018.

questions.explanation: 延誤是與抵達時間相關的間接回答。

questions.prompt: Have you made the hotel reservation yet?
questions.explanation: 表示稍後會做，是合理的間接回答。

questions.prompt: Would you mind sending me the itinerary?
questions.explanation: Would you mind...? 是禮貌請求。

keyTakeaway: 看到動詞題，先找時間線索。
